_comment: StackChan device SD card configuration template
_comment2: Place this file on the SD card as config.json (or flash via NVS)
_comment3: The robot reads this on boot to find the AI server

_notes.websocket_url: Replace YOUR_SERVER_LAN_IP with your server's LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.100). Port 12800 is the default stackchan-ai-server WebSocket port.
_notes.wifi: 2.4 GHz WiFi only — the ESP32 in StackChan does not support 5 GHz.
_notes.protocol: Xiaozhi binary WebSocket protocol (OPUS audio frames + control messages)
